entries.name: GitOps
entries.why: Git is the only way to change a cluster. 30+ ArgoCD apps, no drift.

entries.name: Relationship-based authorization (ReBAC / Zanzibar)
entries.why: Roles don't scale in multi-tenant products. Relations do.

entries.name: Multi-tenancy by design
entries.why: Tenant isolation is an architecture decision, checked by security review.

entries.name: Database per service
entries.why: Clear ownership. Services integrate through events, not shared tables.

entries.name: Event-driven integration
entries.why: A broker decouples services and long-running jobs.

entries.name: Contract validation & blocking quality gates
entries.why: ~3,000 tests, ≥90% coverage. CI blocks the merge.

entries.name: Infrastructure as Code
entries.why: Terraform with remote state. The cloud console is read-only.

entries.name: Cost-aware scheduling (FinOps)
entries.why: Off-hours shutdown cut cluster compute cost by 63%.

entries.name: Metadata-driven regulatory models
entries.why: New regulatory tables without a new release.

entries.name: Dimensional modelling (star schema)
entries.why: Still the clearest way to serve reporting.

entries.name: Context-window-aware incremental summarization
entries.why: Long documents on CPU-only hardware.

entries.name: Air-gapped AI deployment
entries.why: Models, updates and audit with no Internet access.

entries.name: On-chain notarization of credentials
entries.why: JCS + SHA-256 hash on Algorand, publicly verifiable.

entries.name: RAG with self-hosted models
entries.why: Assistants that never send data to third parties.

entries.name: AI coding agents in the delivery loop
entries.why: Real speed-up. The quality gates stay the judge.

entries.name: AI Act compliance by design
entries.why: Regulation as an architecture constraint, not an afterthought.

entries.name: Shared database across services
entries.why: It creates a distributed monolith.

entries.name: ClickOps (manual changes in cloud consoles)
entries.why: Not reproducible, not auditable.

entries.name: Kubernetes
entries.why: My default runtime for anything with more than one service.

entries.name: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
entries.why: Migrated East US → Italy North with zero data loss.

entries.name: Istio (mTLS)
entries.why: Zero-trust between services without touching app code.

entries.name: ArgoCD
entries.why: The GitOps engine I trust in production.

entries.name: Terraform
entries.why: One language for all cloud resources.

entries.name: Keycloak / OIDC
entries.why: Standard identity, also federated with LDAP.

entries.name: OpenFGA
entries.why: Zanzibar-style authorization as a service.

entries.name: Envoy ext_authz
entries.why: Authorization at the edge of every service.

entries.name: KEDA
entries.why: Event-driven autoscaling.

entries.name: Sealed Secrets
entries.why: Secrets live in Git, encrypted.

entries.name: RabbitMQ
entries.why: Boring, reliable messaging.

entries.name: MinIO
entries.why: S3 API anywhere, also on-prem.

entries.name: Docker
entries.why: The unit of delivery.

entries.name: GitHub Actions
entries.why: CI with quality gates close to the code.

entries.name: Azure DevOps Pipelines
entries.why: Fine where the client already uses it.

entries.name: Traefik
entries.why: Simple ingress for single-host, on-prem setups.

entries.name: Hetzner + lightweight managed Kubernetes
entries.why: For small SaaS: full control for under €30/month.

entries.name: Algorand
entries.why: Cheap, fast public notarization.

entries.name: LoRaWAN
entries.why: Low-power sensors across whole buildings.

entries.name: WhatsApp Business API
entries.why: Users love it. Per-message cost needs watching.

entries.name: Docker Swarm
entries.why: Kubernetes won. Legacy only.

entries.name: SharePoint on-prem intranets
entries.why: Heavy to evolve and to operate.

entries.name: TypeScript
entries.why: One type system from API to UI.

entries.name: Node.js
entries.why: 20+ production microservices.

entries.name: Hono
entries.why: Small, fast, standards-based.

entries.name: Python
entries.why: The language of AI and data jobs.

entries.name: FastAPI
entries.why: Typed APIs with little ceremony.

entries.name: Celery
entries.why: Long AI jobs out of the request path.

entries.name: React
entries.why: My default for product UIs.

entries.name: TanStack Router / Query
entries.why: Server state handled properly.

entries.name: PWA
entries.why: An installable app without app stores.

entries.name: Java / Spring Boot
entries.why: Still my choice for data-heavy regulatory backends.

entries.name: SQL (T-SQL, PL/pgSQL)
entries.why: Business logic close to the data, when it belongs there.

entries.name: Rust
entries.why: Authorization sidecar: small, fast, safe.

entries.name: Fastify
entries.why: A good alternative to Hono for Node-only services.

entries.name: Redux Toolkit
entries.why: For new projects: server state belongs to TanStack Query.

entries.name: J2EE / EJB
entries.why: Spring Boot does it with less weight.

entries.name: GWT / GXT
entries.why: Dead end for web UIs.

entries.name: ASP.NET WebForms
entries.why: Legacy only.

entries.name: PostgreSQL
entries.why: My default database.

entries.name: Redis
entries.why: Queues, cache, short-lived state.

entries.name: Elasticsearch
entries.why: Search and log analytics.

entries.name: SQL Server
entries.why: Strong in enterprise data warehouses.

entries.name: MongoDB
entries.why: Only where documents really fit better than tables.

entries.name: Whisper
entries.why: Reliable offline speech-to-text.

entries.name: xAPI / SCORM / cmi5
entries.why: E-learning interoperability.

entries.name: NVIDIA NeMo
entries.why: Offline speech and translation models.

entries.name: PyTorch (inference)
entries.why: Model serving without GPUs.

entries.name: Ollama
entries.why: The easiest way to run local LLMs.

entries.name: Open Badges 3.0 / European Digital Credentials
entries.why: Verifiable, portable credentials.

entries.name: Oracle ODI / CDC-based ETL
entries.why: Replaced by code-first pipelines.
